state.contract: The existing cold epoch is held and authenticated by boot/nonce/sequence. Software ownership must precede original side effects and persist after ambiguous partial failure. Mutex ownership/readback, table geometry and modeled registers are not physical DMA exclusion/coherency/retirement evidence. No rollback/reset/reclaim API exists.
state.proposed_owner: Capture the unique existing type1 WLAN-arena reservation under original allocator lock18. Retain host metadata, shared-index and native-register write progress for both TX bands, plus the fixed token-limit publication, without clearing claims on failure. Original writes must pass per-write identity/order/value guards and readback. Use authenticated cold commands in the main raw setup regression; its later direct TXDONE lease remains explicitly modeled.
